messages:
Devon: Starting bring-up for a new GPU pool in ap-southeast-2. We want an observability footprint that’s "slim" for initial traffic — logs+metrics+traces with tight retention and aggressive sampling to keep cost low. Goal: validation checklist, minimal dashboards, and a couple of alert templates we can hand off to oncall. Who can own validation and final handoff?

Maria: I can own the dashboard templates and the Loki retention bits. Quick Q: are we doing node-level log aggregation only (no application-level full retention) for the first 30d?

Devon: Yes — node/system logs 30d, app logs sampled 1% by default for 30d, keep 7d for higher-signal services. We’ll bump retention later after telemetry analysis.

Aj: Drafted a minimal Prometheus scrape + remote_write plan and a Loki/Fluentd filter for sampling. Paste of the core pieces:

```yaml
# prometheus scrape config (minimal)
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: node-exporter
    static_configs:
      - targets: ['node1:9100','node2:9100']
    metrics_path: /metrics
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_node_label_role]
        regex: gpu.*
        action: keep

remote_write:
  - url: https://remote-write.redwood/api/v1/write
    queue_config:
      max_shards: 2
      max_samples_per_send: 1000
```

```yaml
# Fluentd sample filter for app logs (sample 1%)
<filter kubernetes.var.log.containers.*>
  @type grep
  <regexp>
    key message
    pattern (ERROR|WARN)|.*\\b(job-critical)\\b
  </regexp>
  @label @SAMPLE
</filter>

<label @SAMPLE>
  @type sample
  rate 0.01
</label>
```

Aj: For traces we’ll use Jaeger in agent mode forwarding to collector in VPC with 7d retention. Keep 10% sampling on app spans initially.

Priya: For alerts — start with three templates: cluster-health, node-disk-pressure, GPU-utilization anomalies. Sketches:
- cluster-health: prometheus rule for >5% failed pods across GPU node pool for 5m
- node-disk-pressure: node_filesystem_avail_bytes < 10% for 10m
- gpu-utilization: if avg(nvidia_gpu_utilization{pool="ap-sg-gpu"}) < 5% for 30m on a busy pool (possible mis-scheduling) OR >95% for 15m (capacity risk)

Priya: Example alert rule (Prometheus):

```yaml
- alert: GPUHighUtilization
  expr: avg_over_time(nvidia_gpu_utilization{env="prod",pool="ap-sg-gpu"}[15m]) > 95
  for: 15m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "GPU utilization high on ap-sg-gpu pool"
    runbook: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-high-util"
```

Tobias: Cost tradeoffs — we should pick these defaults to keep initial AUs low: metrics retention 15d (rollup to 1m after 48h), traces 7d, logs 30d but at 1% sample for app logs with options to pin service logs (for critical jobs) at 100%. This will reduce cardinality and egress.

Tobias: Also recommend aggressive label reduction on metrics (drop pod_name/container_id) and use metric relabeling to keep cardinality bounded.

Luke: Handoff checklist I’ll use for oncall + infra ops:
- [ ] Validate scrape targets + no missing GPU nodes (prometheus_targets API)
- [ ] Smoke metrics: run prom query for node_exporter metrics and nvidia exporter
- [ ] Smoke logs: run "loki query" for a known marker from init job
- [ ] Traces: run synthetic with trace-id and verify ingestion in Jaeger
- [ ] Run alert test harness: simulate GPUHighUtilization with metric forge tool
- [ ] Document retention/cost rationale and owners in the ticket
- [ ] Toggle: rollback to full logging if we hit high error rates during ramp

Devon: For the smoke tests — add quick commands:

- Prometheus targets check:
  curl -sS "http://prom:9090/api/v1/targets" | jq '.data.activeTargets[] | {scrapePool, discoveredLabels}'

- Loki smoke query (last 15m for init marker):
  curl -G "http://loki:3100/loki/api/v1/query_range" --data-urlencode 'query={job="gpu-init"} |= "INIT_OK"' --data-urlencode 'limit=1'

- Jaeger: create a synthetic span via curl to the tracing endpoint and check traces in UI within 2m.

Maria: Dashboard notes: create a single "GPU cluster health (slim)" dashboard with panels:
- cluster-level GPU utilization (avg/95th)
- node disk % available
- pod crashloop count (last 1h)
- flamegraph link for a sample job (link out to jaeger)
Make it read-only and share with SRE and platform.

Priya: Alert routing: page severity -> oncall-primary, email -> platform-owners. For non-prod pools route to #eng-dev with lower severity.

ops-bot: Automated check: observability-templates-apply job started for ap-southeast-2 (job id: obs-apply-210345). I will post results when done. :gear:

Devon: Security/egress note — ensure remote_write and Loki endpoints use private link to logging cluster; do not allow public egress for metrics/logs. Whoever configures LB please enable internal-only and use KMS for remote_write creds.

Tobias: Small perf note — enable compressed remote_write (snappy) and batching window 30s to reduce requests. Also set prom max_samples_per_send lower for constrained controllers.

Luke: Ops handoff: once ops-bot reports success I’ll run the checklist and then set a calendar handoff meeting with oncall for next Wednesday. If any owner wants to pre-check let me know.

ops-bot: observability-templates-apply job completed: 5/6 templates applied, 1 failed (gpu-alerts.yml) — error: invalid label in rule.

Aj: I’ll take the rule failure now. Quick fix: rename label "pool" -> "gpu_pool" in the rule; we removed a label earlier. Pushing patch in 5.

Devon: Great. Once Aj patches, ops-bot re-run and Luke signoff, we can mark this as ready-for-handoff. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
